commit.message:
Export of internal GoogleSQL changes.

--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Support supports_order_by in Java FunctionArgumentTypeOptions
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Remove unnecessary reader mutex locking after Prepare() in Evaluator
--
Change by Alex Hirschberg <no-reply@google.com>:
Clarify operator precedence comments in googlesql.tm
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Reject GROUPING() in graph MEASURE expressions with a clean error.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Document TVF table argument column resolution semantics.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Added the report_format argument to syntax examples in Differential private aggregate functions.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
No public description
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Support stored/lexical search columns for `ALTER VECTOR INDEX` in GoogleSQL analyzer & resolved AST.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Populate element_tables in GraphTableQueryResolver and GraphDmlResolver
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
No public description
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Add ResolvedDeleteScan node in GoogleSQL
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Populate element_tables in GraphTableQueryResolver and GraphDmlResolver
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Allow hyphens in string-literal connection paths in WITH CONNECTION
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Disallow dynamic property value types that do not support JSON conversion
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Add analyzer, TableNameResolver, and SQLBuilder support for TVF table arguments with PARTITION BY and ORDER BY
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Add element_tables to GraphElementTypeProto and update serialization
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Add initial SQLBuilder function skeletons for GQL DML DELETE.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Disallow modifying JSON fields in `UPDATE ... SET` without `FEATURE_JSON_SUBFIELDS_WITH_SET`.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
No public description
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Avoid copying the inner value when constructing a variant value.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Implement FunctionCallBuilder::In for the FN_IN SQL function.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Support untyped `STRUCT(...)` syntax in `SQLBuilder`
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Add element_tables to GraphElementType and union in Coercer
--
Change by Divyanshu Ranjan <divyanshur@google.com>:
Add rewriter for the LookupTable table-valued function
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Fix GROUP ROWS reading wrong tuple slots in the reference implementation
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Stop dropping NULL rows from ARRAY and scalar GROUP ROWS subqueries in reference impl
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Refresh HLL / Approx Aggregate Documents
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Extract table names from pipe FORK, TEE and LOG subpipelines.
--
Change by Divyanshu Ranjan <divyanshur@google.com>:
Add the LookupTable table-valued function.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Add Value::VariantNull() support.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
No public description
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Refine descriptions for GoogleSQL hash functions.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Add GoogleSQL VARIANT_VALUE builtin function signature and analyzer tests
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Add GoogleSQL SCHEMA_OF_VARIANT and SCHEMA_OF_VARIANT_AGG builtin function signatures and analyzer tests
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Add GoogleSQL VARIANT_TYPE builtin function signature and analyzer tests
--
Change by Oleh Prypin <oprypin@google.com>:
No public description
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Move function-typed parameter substitution into ResolvedArgumentRefReplacer
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Refactor ResolvedArgumentRefReplacer into substitution and correlation passes.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Add GoogleSQL IS_VARIANT_NULL builtin function signature and analyzer tests
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Remove `in_development` from `FEATURE_JSONPATH_WILDCARDS_AND_DESCENDANT`.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
No public description
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
relaxes ResolvedUpdateStmt to allow returning columns in FROM clause
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Gracefully handle the error when resolving deeply nested array types.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Add new Resolved AST node and validation for GQL DML DELETE.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Add VariantValueView::ToValue() support.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Add `update_item_column` to ResolvedUpdateFieldItem.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Decode all proto fields in a single wire pass in VariantValueView::GetMembers()
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Implement DELETE with USING clause in GoogleSQL reference implementation.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Issue a warning when ALIGN is used as an unquoted identifier.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Support `FEATURE_JSONPATH_WILDCARDS_AND_DESCENDANT` in reference implementation and compliance tests.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Add test cases demonstrating STRUCT arguments bug in `AI.IF`.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Add parser and unparser support for TVF table arguments with PARTITION BY and ORDER BY
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
No public description
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
No public description
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Fixes GoogleSQL validator to validate empty column list specs correctly
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Updating links to directly resolve to docs.cloud.google.com.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Fix resolution of named MODEL, SEQUENCE, and FUNCTION reference arguments
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Add GoogleSQL VARIANT_QUERY builtin function signature and analyzer support
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Add failing analyzer tests for out-of-order named MODEL, SEQUENCE, and FUNCTION arguments
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Introduces LookupKey as the common function for HasKey and GetKeyValue()
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
No public description
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Clarify leading zero behavior for year format elements in SQL docs
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Document how to handle NULL values before aggregating
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Add FEATURE_SQL_GRAPH_CROSS_ENTITY_SCALAR_PROPERTIES language feature.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Add multi-match wildcard (`.*`, `[*]`) and recursive descendant (`..`) evaluation to `JsonPathEvaluator` for `JSON` inputs.
--
Change by John Morcos <jmorcos@google.com>:
Always propagate the status and do not alter its code in AnnotationPropagator.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Implement `FormatValueContent` for `VARIANT` values.
--
Change by John Morcos <jmorcos@google.com>:
Support GraphElementType as a source of CAST to JSON.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Automated Code Change
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Allow empty join columns in TableRefType and fail in RowTypeRewriter
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Fix comment on GqlQueryContext::is_nested.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Populate Model in InputArgumentType for scalar functions with MODEL arguments.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Clarify evaluation error behavior and subquery execution for conditional expressions.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Updates the README doc
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Expanded comment for VariantValueAdapter.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Further minor optimizations in variant_value.cc.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Optimize JSON traversal in VariantValueAdapter by avoiding sub-tree copies.
--
Change by Alex Hirschberg <no-reply@google.com>:
Fix FunctionSignatureIsDisabled bug, with allowlist for legacy behavior.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Supports Graph DML UPDATE sql builder
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Add variant_value to ValueProto oneof.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Update FARM_FINGERPRINT documentation with output range.
--
Change by GoogleSQL Team <no-reply@google.com>:
Refactor JSONPath parser into structured `ParsedJsonPath` steps to support parsing wildcard (`.*`, `[*]`) and recursive descendant (`..`) operators in JSONPath .
